instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor conducting a reassessment. Analyse the prior assessment summary, changes since last assessment, and updated survey, then respond with a complete reassessment JSON including score_delta, carry_forward, progress, and comparison_to_previous.

answers.companyDescription: Forestry management cooperative overseeing 5,000 hectares of sustainable pine and eucalyptus plantation. Supplies pulp and timber to paper mills. Evaluating satellite-based forest health monitoring and carbon credit certification programs. A tight-knit operation where everyone wears multiple hats. We have no dedicated innovation budget — improvements happen opportunistically when the team identifies a clear bottleneck affecting our core operations or customer experience.
answers.pastInitiatives: We successfully deployed a new CRM system across the sales team 18 months ago, which improved lead tracking and reduced pipeline data entry time by 30%. The implementation was well-planned with dedicated project management and training. Building on this success, we are now exploring marketing automation integration and AI-assisted lead scoring.
answers.strategicGoals: Our board has set an ambitious revenue target of reaching €50M ARR within 5 years from our current base. This requires us to expand our addressable market, potentially pivot pricing models from one-time to recurring revenue, and build a repeatable enterprise sales motion. We need to identify the highest-leverage growth levers without overextending our cash runway.
answers.teamSize: We have 2 generalist developers who split their time between maintaining our existing systems, handling customer support escalations, and occasionally prototyping new features. There is no dedicated innovation or R&D role — innovation happens when these developers have spare cycles between urgent operational tasks, which is rare.
answers.additionalContext: We have a new CEO who joined 3 months ago from a more digitally mature industry. She has signaled that innovation and digital transformation will be top strategic priorities, replacing the previous leadership's conservative, cost-cutting orientation. The organization is cautiously optimistic but also uncertain about what concrete changes to expect.

input.changes_since_last: Product launch successful — 3 new features shipped. Customer NPS improved 25 points. Backlog of technical debt growing.

opportunities.title: Implement Full-Cycle Sales Automation and AI Lead Scoring
opportunities.rationale: Building on the successful CRM deployment, the next logical step is integrating marketing automation and advanced lead scoring. This moves the sales motion from manual tracking to a repeatable, measurable process essential for achieving €50M ARR goals.

first_actions: Formalize integration scope between CRM and chosen Marketing Automation platform (MAP).
Design three distinct lead scoring criteria weighted by profitability potential.
Pilot the new workflow with a small, dedicated segment of the sales team.
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction of lead qualification time by 40% and a measured increase in SQL conversion rate.
milestones: MAP platform selection and vendor integration complete.
Lead scoring model finalized and tested against historical data.
Full rollout across all sales territories.

opportunities.title: Develop Digital Carbon/ESG Monitoring Platform
opportunities.rationale: The high-level strategic goal and the evaluation of satellite technology point toward a new, recurring revenue stream (carbon credits, ESG monitoring). Developing this platform addresses the need to expand the addressable market and de-risks future growth efforts.

first_actions: Conduct feasibility study on integrating third-party satellite data APIs into a prototype dashboard.
Identify 2-3 pilot enterprise clients willing to co-design the monitoring dashboard requirements.
Map out the technical requirements for handling complex carbon accounting standards.
resources_needed: Technical partner specializing in GIS/Satellite Data
Dedicated time from core developer team (0.5 FTE)
execution_plan.success_metric: Successful proof-of-concept dashboard demonstrating real-time forest health metrics for a pilot client.
milestones: Data source integration and ETL process established.
MVP platform demo presented to the board/leadership.
Secure Letter of Intent (LOI) from an initial paying customer.

next_steps.action: Formalize an Innovation Roadmap (3-year plan) with measurable milestones and resource allocation, led by the CEO.
Allocate dedicated (even if part-time) development resources specifically for the ESG Platform PoC, ring-fencing them from maintenance tasks.
Conduct external training/consulting on creating a repeatable enterprise sales motion and understanding recurring revenue metrics (ARR).

key_weaknesses: Critical resource constraint: Lack of dedicated, non-operational R&D talent leads to reactive, opportunistic development.
Strategic clarity gap between immediate operational improvements (CRM) and long-term market pivoting (ESG/ARR).
Formalized sales methodology is missing; growth efforts rely on generalist effort rather than scalable process.

improvements: Significant strategic momentum gained with the new CEO's focus.
Key operational processes (lead tracking) are stable and reliable thanks to CRM deployment.
persistent_gaps: The core constraints of time and talent remain the primary limiting factors for ambitious growth targets.
Budget is still seen as a barrier, despite the need for major investment in new platforms (ESG/MAP).
Transitioning from project-by-project implementation to a systematic, repeatable revenue generation model.
achieved_milestones: Successful product launch with 3 core feature enhancements.
NPS improvement of 25 points confirms better customer experience delivery.
Stabilization and improvement of foundational sales data management via CRM.

comparison_to_previous.key_changes: The shift in leadership and the successful product launch provided critical momentum. The focus has moved from foundational stability (CRM) to ambitious strategic growth (ARR targets), demanding a higher level of digital rigor.
